content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). This payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so those paths are unavailable. Resubmitting as-is or with records won't fix a missing pre-service auth, and there's no data error to correct. The only legitimate progression is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, which is permitted since a denial is on the table.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
